visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a steaming dish of shredded potatoes mixed with red chili peppers. A hand enters from above to garnish the dish with shredded green scallions and more red chili slivers. Bold white characters identifying the dish as '醋溜土豆絲' and the logo '@wecook123' are visible. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the gloss of the stir-fried potatoes. (2) A close-up shows wooden chopsticks lifting a bundle of translucent, thin potato strands. The strands are glistening with oil and dotted with black pepper and chili flakes. The background is a soft-focus kitchen environment, keeping the focus entirely on the food's texture. (3) A hand holds a large, unpeeled potato against a kitchen background. The chef then uses a silver handheld peeler to strip the skin away in long, vertical motions, revealing the pale yellow flesh. The hand moves with steady precision. (4) On a wooden cutting board, the peeled potato is sliced into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife. The chef then stacks these rounds and juliennes them into very fine, uniform strips. The hands move with professional speed and accuracy. (5) The julienned potatoes are submerged into a clear glass bowl filled with water. A hand reaches in to agitate the potatoes to wash off the excess starch, causing the water to become slightly cloudy and white. (6) In a black non-stick pan, dried Sichuan peppercorns are poured from a small dish, followed by a pour of sesame oil. The ingredients begin to sizzle as they heat up. A silicone spatula is used to stir the mixture. (7) The chef pours the heated oil and peppercorns through a metal mesh strainer into a glass bowl. The dark peppercorns are caught in the sieve while the aromatic infused oil collects in the bowl below. (8) The infused oil, some peppercorns, dried chili segments, and minced garlic are combined in the pan. The chef adds the soaked potato shreds and performs multiple skillful pan tosses, flipping the ingredients high into the air. (9) Sequential seasonings are added: white sugar, black pepper, more peppercorns, fresh chili rings, salt, and white vinegar. Each ingredient is added from small glass containers while the chef continues to stir and toss the pan vigorously. (10) The final shot returns to the plated dish, where the chef again garnishes the top with shredded scallions and chili. The presentation is vibrant and the steam suggests it is freshly cooked.
